name: flow_difficulty_offline_spec_names_the_hub_level
description: Offline the level is the profile's (M8, contract-m8 §3; design 2.6): saved in user://profile.cfg beside the mode and read back at the next launch; every match the hub starts asks for it where the mode takes one: the spec of Play in High Water, a Try (solo High Water) and Race the caretaker names Hard, Duel the caretaker's and classic's Normal; Play from the hub hands the match scene the level in match_spec, and an unknown level is no level. This holds the session's side only: the match scene building its offline match from match_spec's level is main.gd's (track B), for the finishing pass after both merge to hold (MatchRules.of(mode, difficulty), and main's sim.rules at Hard).

steps.msg: a first launch is at Normal
offline, the profile's level; an unknown one changes nothing
saved beside the mode, read back at the next launch
Play in High Water asks for Hard
a Try, a solo High Water, asks for Hard
Race the caretaker asks for Hard: both hollows at one level
Duel the caretaker asks for Normal
classic asks for Normal: M1's game
Play from the hub names High Water at Hard in the match scene's match_spec (main.gd builds from it: track B's)
